relationships.evidence_quote: Isoeugenol at 1 mM induces a shift in the midpoint of the inactivation curves (V0.5-iNact) by −15.06 ± 3.368 mV (Paired t test, p = 0.0066).

key_findings: Isoeugenol fully and reversibly inhibits sodium currents in rat DRG neurons (IC50 about 1 mM), accelerates activation and shifts the inactivation curve by about -15 mV.
Isoeugenol does not show enhanced affinity for inactivated states (no frequency dependence, modest delay in recovery), unlike lidocaine, suggesting binding to pre-open closed states.
